name: hmi_upload_import_file
description: Upload a file to a staged HMI JSON import using sequential Base64 chunks.

content_base64.description: Base64-encoded bytes for this chunk; chunks are limited to 512 KiB decoded.

offset.description: Byte offset of this chunk; start at zero and use receivedBytes from the previous response.

relative_path.description: Relative file path, such as manifest.json or screens/0001-Main.json.

total_bytes.description: Total decoded file size in bytes, no more than 10 MiB.

transfer_id.description: Import transfer ID returned by hmi_begin_import.
